svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of global cumulative CO₂ emissions
Cumulative emissions are the running sum of annual emissions since 1750. This measures fossil fuel and
industry emissions. Land-use change emissions are not included.
